tagline_en: Silent .sdf errors—flipped joints, wrong inertia units—blow up in Gazebo. It validates tag-by-tag and hands you a.
desc_en: SDFormat/SDF model and world authoring, validation, and simulator handoff. Use for `.sdf` files, SDFormat XML, models, worlds, links, joints, poses, frames, inertials, visual/collision geometry, mesh URIs, sensors, lights, physics, plugins, includes, Gazebo, static SDF review, or simulator-specific metadata. Do not use for signed-distance-field geometry.
why_zh: 机制上是校验与交接一体：不只查 XML 语法，还核对 SDFormat 语义、单位、参考系。
why_en: Combines validation and handoff: checks SDFormat semantics, units, and frames, then outputs a Gazebo-loadable model or.
limit_zh: 只认 SDFormat 的 .sdf 文件，不碰 URDF、MJCF 或 signed-distance-field …
limit_en: Only handles SDFormat .sdf files—not URDF, MJCF, or SDF geometry. External mesh URIs must be locally accessible or validation stops at the reference.
title_en: SDF models pass simulator check before release
